text:
elaine: Heads-up team — finalizing logistics for next Thursday webinar 'Benchmarking Inference Cost & Latency'. Need owners for reg page UTM capture, timezone-aware reminders, captions/subtitles workflow, recording retention, clip pulls, and post-event nurture rules. Who can take what?
jen: I can do reg page + email templates. We should capture utm_source, utm_campaign, and a freeform 'use_case' text area. Also include preferred timezone select so calendar invites match local time.
sam: I'll take nurture and SFDC mapping. Proposed SFDC fields: Lead.Webinar_Campaign__c, Lead.Use_Case__c, Lead.UTM_Source__c, Lead.Webinar_Status__c (registered/live/watched). Also plan scoring: +30 for enterprise email domain, +20 for title match, +10 for 60+ mins watched.
viv: Design will prepare hero art and 3 social cuts. For reg page copy let's test two CTAs: 'Join live' vs 'Get recording' and record CTA choice to SFDC. Also we should surface a short agenda to reduce no-shows.
mike: I'll handle Zoom config and recording. Settings: cloud recording (host+shared), enable audio transcript, enable automatic captioning (Zoom ASR), also enable SRT out for captioning ingest. Alternative hosts: @viv and @jordan. Turn on passcode and waiting room.
jordan: Legal check — include explicit consent checkbox: "I consent to being recorded and contacted about Redwood products". No pre-checked boxes. Also include link to privacy/privacy-contacts. Need archived copy for compliance.
sam: For lead routing: rule flow: if email domain in enterprise_domains list OR job_title contains 'Director|VP|Head|Principal' => route to AE queue. If utm_campaign contains 'benchmark-enterprise' => assign AE. Otherwise SDR. Also set up automation to tag 'source_webinar' and 'utm_campaign' on lead.
jen: Reminder cadence proposal: 3 days, 24 hours, 1 hour. Use timezone select to compute send time. Calendar invite should include passcode and dial-in + web link. For folks who chose 'Get recording', send recording only.
mike: RTMP fallback: eng-platform — can we provision short-lived RTMP ingestion and an S3 sink? Last minute failover to YouTube private if RTMP not reachable. Also enable auto-download of cloud recording to S3 and retention 90 days.
eng-platform-bot: RTMP endpoint created: rtmp://internal-rtmp.redwood/ebb2a7. Expires 9 days. S3 bucket pre-signed path: s3://redwood-webinars/1711123456/. Lambda for postprocessing created.
jordan: Transcripts: let's run ASR (Zoom) for live captions, then route cloud recording to Rev for verbatim transcripts and higher-quality captions. Rev will output VTT and SRT into S3, and we will push to CDN for replay page.
viv: Clips — marketing wants 3 highlight clips: 30s product hook, 60s benchmark stat, 90s customer quote. During event, we'll mark clip timestamps via Zoom reactions or 'marker' chat: "CLIP:00:15:30-00:16:20 - benchmark stat". Mike, can we enable recording markers?
mike: Zoom has a manual timestamp in chat approach. I'll run the marker sheet and record timestamps. Also enable livestream recording for auto-highlights in Otter as fallback.
elaine: Post-event nurture flow: Immediately send recording link to opted-in recipients; 24h later send 1-2 highlight clips + slides + CTA to benchmark whitepaper; 3 days later targeted sales outreach based on score; 2 weeks later long-term drip. Tag watched_% thresholds in SFDC and add to nurture lists.
sam: Can we add tracking pixels to the replay page for ad retargeting? Marketing only — privacy ok? Jordan, confirm cookie consent needs.
jordan: We must show cookie banner on replay if tracking pixels fire; add opt-out link. For EU registrants, ensure we only fire pixels after consent.
viv: Asset handoff: I'll upload hero and three social assets to Figma by EOD Wednesday. Jen, can you add copy variations to the reg page A/B test?
jen: Yep. I'll also wire up UTM tracking on buttons and test the Zapier -> SFDC pipeline with a dummy lead on Wednesday morning.
elaine: Great. Final checklist and owners: jen = reg page, timezone invites, utm capture; mike = Zoom + markers + RTMP test (Tue 11am); sam = SFDC mapping, scoring, nurture rules; viv = creative + clip specs; jordan = legal/consent + captions policy; eng-platform-bot = RTMP + S3 + lambda (done). We'll run a full dress rehearsal Wed at 4pm. Add notes in the event doc and ping me when done. :rocket:
